# UC32 — Live-reconfigure the gateway's scope policy

**Track:** controls  
**Maturity:** ✅ `works`  
**OWASP:** 🛡️ **OWASP ASI** — Threats: T6 · Sections: §4.2.2

## Buyer Story

A demo of a policy control isn't credible if the policy is actually hardcoded in the app. The business needs to change the rule itself — live, without a code change or a restart — and see the SAME request's outcome flip.

## PingOne Solution

An admin-editable Allowed State control, right on the gateway capability card, changes ff_weather_mcp_allowed_state live; the Agent Gateway reads it on the very next request, no restart.

## How to Run

**Trigger:** Trigger (link): `{"type":"link","path":"/agent-gateway-capabilities","label":"Open Capability Tour"}`  
**Expected outcome:** `POLICY_RECONFIGURED`

## What to Say

> Watch: the same "weather in Miami" query — denied under Texas, permitted the moment I switch this dropdown to Any.
